items.title: feat: opt-in guard against unbounded UPDATE/DELETE and TRUNCATE in write
items.summary:
### Problem / Motivation

With `database.read_only: false`, the `write` tool runs any data-changing statement the agent sends. One wrong statement can wipe or rewrite a whole table:

```sql
DELETE FROM users;                          -- every row
UPDATE orders SET status = 'cancelled';     -- every row
TRUNCATE users;                             -- empties the table
```

items.title: Release: delete the release branch when the release step fails
items.summary:
## Problem
When `.github/scripts/release.sh pass` fails after it created the branch `release/vX.Y.Z`, its exit trap deletes only the `rel-*` tag. The branch stays on origin, and the next `git rel-*` fails at the branch creation ("Reference already exists") until the branch is deleted by hand.
